prompt: Our editors want the Tidy copy-edit button to work, and Tidy is currently switched off. Turn it on with the cheaper Claude Haiku 4.5 model, keep our house style settings as they are, and let each Tidy call run for up to 60 seconds because ours are slow. Separately, we want to tell AI training crawlers not to train on our public site, in the robots.txt the site serves. I'll add the Anthropic key myself, so tell me what to run. It's done when the site type-checks, the repo holds everything Tidy needs except the key, and the robots.txt the site serves declines AI training.
